author: Ricepop67
quote: This is not a gta game it feels more like saints row than gta the cut scenes lack that well knowing gta feeling, the protagonist are woefully bland Jason has less personality than tombstone Lucia is unbeatably annoying feels like she’s forcing herself into this life of crime she does not fit well into the underworld of robbing banks and her personality does not make up for that. out side of the story the game does have some things to offer but at the end of the day gta has always been a story driven game and side quests and mini games are called side quests for a reason does not live upto any other gta games. Rockstar substituted narrative drive for simulation crash, the rise of rp servers has clearly had major impact on this new gta game which as a sub genre is incredibly disappointing. It’s not  gta 6 it’s saints row with the gta title on it
